subject: Foundry Launch — request for starter stipend swap & packaging clarity
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@foundrylaunch.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@foundrylaunch.com
Date: 2029-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Starter stipend — can we swap to onboarding credits?

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. Quick question on our Foundry Launch package — the program provides a $12k starter stipend, but our cohort has varying needs and our platform team prefers staged onboarding credits tied to milestones (sandbox credits usable over 6 months).

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider a one-time swap of up to $10k of the starter stipend into onboarding/sandbox credits that are refundable if we convert to a 6-month Dedicated commit?
- Can those swapped credits stack with the early-bird promotional discount you mentioned in the demo? Our legal/procurement need clarity for invoicing and accounting.

I’ve attached our standard SOW and the program milestone map so you can see timelines. Procurement looped in for invoicing terms.

Attachments: Foundry_SOW.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Emma

Emma Park
Program Lead, Foundry Launch
emma@foundrylaunch.com
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Park <emma@foundrylaunch.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starter stipend — can we swap to onboarding credits?

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW.

Short answer: we can probably accommodate a one-time swap but need to align internal approvals (sales + partnerships + legal/finance) and confirm the exact mechanics. A few quick notes:

- Operational approach we recommend: convert up to $10k of the stipend into time-bound sandbox/onboarding credits issued as prepaid consumption units. Those units would be tagged to Foundry Launch and available for 6 months.
- Stacking: our standard promo stacking rules disallow stacking promotional discounts with committed-rate discounts, but a one-time exception for program cohorts is possible with an explicit addendum.
- Dependencies: legal addendum + procurement OK (net terms), and finance requires a Deal ID for tracking.

I’m attaching an internal request form I’ll file with ops so we can route a one-off exception. Can Marissa and Ben help confirm whether we can offer stackable promo and whether we require a Dedicated commit to trigger convertibility/refund? Also, procurement: what invoice cadence and net terms do you need?

Next steps I propose: I’ll open RDW-FTY-8423 and loop Legal. If you can confirm procurement contact and preferred invoice terms I’ll draft the addendum for DocuSign.

Attachment: jonas-stipend-exception.docx (internal exception request stub)

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Emma Park <emma@foundrylaunch.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-05-21T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starter stipend — can we swap to onboarding credits?

Thanks Jonas + Emma. Quick internal context from pricing/partner ops:

- We can approve a program carve-out that converts up to $10k of the stipend into sandbox/onboarding credits, provided:
  1) The credits are time-limited to 6 months;
  2) Foundry signs a short addendum acknowledging the one-time exception (no retroactive stacking with other cohort promos unless explicitly noted);
  3) If Foundry converts to a 6-month Dedicated commitment within the 6 months, we will allow those credits to be offset against the first invoice up to the $10k value (i.e., conversion credit).

- Stacking: We can permit the early-bird promo discount to apply to usage beyond the swapped credits, but we cannot double-dip the same promo to reduce the effective stipend value. In plain terms: stipend -> onboarding credits (one-time). Promo discount -> applies to paid usage after credits are exhausted.

- Invoicing/terms: Ben, can you confirm if Net 30 invoicing to procurement@foundrylaunch.com is acceptable and whether Finance needs PO on file?

If Foundry agrees, we’ll prepare a 1-page addendum and a DocuSign link. I’ll draft language that covers the swap amount, time window, and conversion-to-commit rule.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Emma Park <emma@foundrylaunch.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@foundrylaunch.com
Date: 2029-05-22T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starter stipend — can we swap to onboarding credits?

Hi Marissa, Jonas — this looks good and clear. Procurement confirms Net 30 is acceptable and they will issue a PO once the addendum is attached to the SOW. Our preference is:

- Swap the full $10k to onboarding/sandbox credits valid for 6 months;
- Allow those credits to offset the first invoice if we move to a 6-month Dedicated commit within that 6-month window;
- Please include a clause that any unused swapped credits after 6 months expire and are non-refundable.

If you can send the DocuSign addendum we’ll route it through procurement and return with PO within 48 hours. Linking procurement contact here: procurement@foundrylaunch.com.

Thanks — Emma

Emma Park
Program Lead, Foundry Launch
